headline: Utility lifts full-year outlook and sets next-year range
summary_short: Ameren Q3 GAAP EPS of $2.42 rose 3% y/y; adjusted EPS rose 11.5% from $2.17. Revenue was $2,882M, up 6.8%, and 2026 EPS guidance was raised to $5.35-$5.55.
summary_long: Net income of $676M compared with $640M a year ago (adjusted $592M). Ameren Missouri earned $582M vs $518M, Transmission $110M, Illinois Electric Distribution $72M, while Illinois Natural Gas lost $7M. The company set 2027 EPS guidance of $5.70-$5.90 and 8%-10% EPS growth for 2027-2031, backed by $38.1B of planned infrastructure investment and about 13.3% annual rate base growth.
confidence_notes: Prior-year adjusted figures exclude a $48M ($0.18/share) Q3 2025 tax benefit from a FERC order. Y/y deltas computed from reported dollar values; the adjusted EPS delta is against the adjusted $2.17 base. Guidance is stated in the summary text only; it was not written to the event shard (no sanctioned script).

drivers.explanation: Higher earnings on infrastructure and innovative-energy-technology investments plus higher Ameren Missouri retail sales on warmer weather, partly offset by higher operations and maintenance and more shares outstanding.
Missouri earnings rose to $582M from $518M on infrastructure investment and warmer-weather sales, partly offset by tree trimming and energy center maintenance costs.
Electric revenue rose to $2,722M from $2,563M and natural gas to $160M from $136M.
Strong year-to-date performance gave management confidence to raise 2026 guidance from $5.25-$5.45 and to introduce 2027 guidance.
